characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Play during a Starting Phase.
Nominate either 1 Zone or 1 Scenario Objective that is on the table.
If a Zone is selected, then for that turn neither player is eligible to Control the chosen Zone, such that no Scenario Points can be scored from that Zone this turn.
If a Scenario Objective is chosen, then for that turn neither player is able to perform any Influence, Prayer, or Worship Actions at the chosen Objective. Also, for that turn no Scenario Points can be earned from the chosen Objective (irrespective of the existing alignment).

This model may use the listed Ki Feats of any Friendly Unknown & Ninja model currently in play and Reikon from Jigoku's Kagenori Vo Koto Ki Feat even if not recruited into this Warband.
It is assumed that the Kagenori No Koto Feat is listed and written on this model's card.

characteristics.name: Traits
characteristics.$text: Armour (1), Assassin, Camouflage (2"), Dodge (1), Flank, Immune [Control], Intangible

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
If this model is Killed or removed from play, the Eclipse model you own suffers two Wounds.
While this model is in play, the Eclipse you own has Soulless and Ki Stat of 0/8.

characteristics.name: Traits
characteristics.$text: Assassin, Camouflage (2"), Durable, Immune [Control], Intangible, Kami

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: During Deployment, this model gains the listed Ki Feat of one Friendly Ninja model in its Warband, it is assumed that the Ki Feat is written on this model's card. If multiple models in the Warband have this rule, they may not choose the same named Ki Feat.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Attached Ninja model gains Immune [Prone].

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Attached model begins the game with a Disguise (6) Marker.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If Attached model is involved in the first Melee Exchange of the game, it gains Unblockable (1) for that Melee Exchange, then discard this card.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Attached model must be on the Battlefield in the Starting Phase of the first turn.
In the Starting Phase of the first turn, Attached model may become Exhausted. If it does so, Attached model cannot be Surprised for the remainder of the game.
While an Enemy Warband has a model with the Tactician trait, the Attached model gains Tactician (1).

Requirement [House Long Shadow Theme]

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Other Friendly Unknown Ninjas gain the following Unique Effect:
While attempting to Target this model, Enemy models lose Sixth Sense.

Requirement [Ghost]

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When the Attached Ninja model ends its activation you may become the Acive Player again and begin another Friendly Ninja model's activation, then discard this card.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Attached Ninja model's weapons gain Poison (1/1).

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Attach model gains this Ki Feat

characteristics.name: Limitation
characteristics.$text: Not in BtB, Once Per Game

characteristics.name: Ki Feat Description
characteristics.$text:
Deploy a Makibishi terrain element template in BtB with this model. Whenever a model without Cloudwalk or Intangible Moves into, or starts its Movement within the Makibishi terrain element, it must perform a Move Challenge Test (X).
X = 8 if the model is performing a Charge or Run Action.
X = 7 otherwise.
If unsuccessful, the model's movement and activation immediately ends.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Attached Ninja model gains Flank.

characteristics.name: Unique Effects
characteristics.$text:
The attached Ninja model gains this Ranged Weapon.
On a successful Attack with this weapon, instead of a Damage Roll, centre a 1" Pulse on the Target and all models in the Pulse treat Enemy models as having Fear (5) until the End Phase.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Attach model gains the Ninjato Melee Weapon.
You may Discard this card to Attach any valid Enhancement - Equipment with Rice Cost of X or lower that was not recruited into the Warband to the Attached model.

Requirement [House North Star Theme]

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Generate an additional Pass Token in the Starting Phase of the first turn of the game for each Friendly model with the Scout trait in the Warband.
While Attached model is in play, you generate an additional Pass Token in the Starting Phase.

Requirement [House Long Shadow Theme]

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
The first time the Attached model Kills an Enemy model, at the end of the current activation place the Attached model anywhere on the Battlefield.
Then discard this card.

Requirement [House Long Shadow Theme]

characteristics.name: Unique Effects
characteristics.$text:
Ona successful attack with this weapon, instead of a Damage Roll, centre a 1" Pulse on the Target and all models in the Pulse gain a Stunned Marker.
After an attack with this weapon, discard this card unless it is attached to a North Star model.
